_comment: Keycloak partial-import for the GitHub identity provider used by the Collab GitHub connector. Import into the hub's realm (Realm settings -> Action -> Partial import, or kcadm). Fill in the two REPLACE_ values from the GitHub OAuth App before importing; prefer injecting clientSecret from your secret store rather than committing it. Alias MUST stay 'github' (apollo-desktop's GitHubConnectorLogin hardcodes it). See docs/github-connector.md.
